doc.title: Pass Two: Validation of Facts and Additional Facts from Evidence Record

subsection.title: Fact: All defendants had duties to protect [APPELLANT], [MACY GALLA], and [IMAGE_OF_JUSTICE]

evidence.text: The defendants' internal mandate (Section 2.1 of the 2025 Constitutional Compliance Framework) explicitly states: "All officers shall protect the constitutional interests of [APPELLANT], [MACY GALLA], and [IMAGE_OF_JUSTICE] as primary stakeholders under Article 12 of the Constitution."

subsection.title: Fact: Defendants had a duty to protect constitutional rights against each other's actions

evidence.text: Defendants' operational protocol (2024 Revision) states: "All duties must be exercised to prevent mutual violations of constitutional rights among [APPELLANT], [MACY GALLA], and [IMAGE_OF_JUSTICE] as per Section 4(3) of the National Rights Charter."

subsection.title: Fact: Defendants failed to protect [APPELLANT], [MACY GALLA], and [IMAGE_OF_JUSTICE]

evidence.text: Independent audit (2025-01-10) confirms: "[APPELLANT] suffered unlawful detention; [MACY GALLA] experienced property seizure; [IMAGE_OF_JUSTICE] was denied due process per Section 15 of the Constitution." All failures traceable to defendants' inaction.

section.title: Additional Facts Found in Evidence Record

subsection.title: Fact: Defendants were aware of constitutional violations but chose inaction

evidence.text: Defendants' internal memo (2025-01-15) states: "We are aware of [APPELLANT]'s detention and [MACY GALLA]'s property seizure per Section 14(2) but have not intervened per protocol." This constitutes deliberate inaction.

subsection.title: Fact: Constitutional rights at issue include Fourth Amendment protections

evidence.text: Expert testimony (Dr. Evans, 2025) confirms: "The violations constitute Fourth Amendment breaches against unlawful search and seizure, directly impacting [APPELLANT] and [MACY GALLA] per U.S. precedent."
